statuses.PASS: Direct executed evidence establishes dynamic behavior; inspected source may establish a purely static requirement.
statuses.FAIL: Observed behavior or inspected source contradicts requirement.
statuses.UNVERIFIED: Not executed, incomplete, tools/evidence unavailable, or self-report without required independent observation.
statuses.NOT_APPLICABLE: Genuinely outside this case with reason; cannot waive requested behavior.

passingRule: Every required applicable criterion must PASS; FAIL or UNVERIFIED blocks unqualified case pass. NOT_APPLICABLE requires evaluator rationale. No aesthetic score, weighted total, 10/10 label or statistical-confidence claim.
coverageRule: Every L01-L24 has exactly one IMPLEMENTED_OR_CHANGED, INHERITED_VERIFIED, OUT_OF_SCOPE or RELEVANT_UNVERIFIED disposition with component and evidence/reason. Dispositions are not test statuses. Narrow tasks can have many OUT_OF_SCOPE entries. Inherited verified requires observation; do not require all24 implementations.
decisionRule: Each material recommendation links requirement, mechanism, operating limit, failure mode and verification. Concise proportionate records suffice; verbosity and mechanism count earn no credit.
evidenceRule: Database invariants need actual SQLite; HTTP requirements need actual HTTP. Preserve commands/exit codes/failures/raw outputs. Mock/code-only/compilation claims do not prove dynamic correctness. Independently repeat fault/recovery checks.
objectiveCriteria: Evaluator-only detailed probes are heldout/grading.json; withhold from implementation agents. Public ID meanings communicate plain task criteria, not grader answers.

comparison.interpretation: Four comparative trials total and four skill-only trials. Show individual observations and exact FAIL/UNVERIFIED counts; no broad/statistical superiority or fabricated savings.

measurementRule: Record actual start/end/elapsed and exposed host token/tool/cost counts only; null with reason when unavailable. Limit breaches remain visible. Three lab optimization samples do not establish throughput or p99.
